subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For `stopReason=stop`, `tools>0`, `payloads=0`, `replaySafe=no` embedded turns, should OpenClaw retry/fail over when current-attempt side effects are provably absent, persist a quarantine-only repair record, or keep the current fail-closed behavior with stronger diagnostics?
rationale: The current fail-closed behavior is intentional safety policy, but fresh field evidence shows it turns intermittent provider empty-turn flakes into recurring hard cron failures; choosing the recovery boundary requires maintainer intent about side-effect replay risk versus availability.

options.title: Narrow Safe Recovery Plus Quarantine
options.body: Allow retry/fallback only for current-attempt-safe empty tool turns and add durable quarantine diagnostics for unsafe attempts.

options.title: Quarantine Only
options.body: Keep automatic retry disabled for replay-unsafe tool attempts but persist explicit repair/quarantine state and stronger operator diagnostics.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Preserve current behavior and document/model-specific workarounds, accepting recurring failures for providers that emit this malformed shape.

recommendation.title: Narrow Safe Recovery Plus Quarantine
recommendation.body: Allow retry/fallback only for current-attempt-safe empty tool turns and add durable quarantine diagnostics for unsafe attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a maintainer product/safety boundary, and prior adjacent incomplete-turn reviews point to this handle for that decision.
